options.content:
几天在同一张图上，纵轴相同。横轴只标日期。鼠标放在柱子上能看到是 10:00、11:00、11:30、14:00 还是 15:00。

同一小时从左到右并排。**蓝是沪市**：上证指数深、上证50浅。**橙是深市**：深证成指深、创业板浅。**绿是沪深300**，**紫是科创50**。成交量是亿手，成交额是亿元。

panels.title: 宽基成交量（亿手）
panels.description: 上证指数、深证成指、沪深300。

targets.rawSql: WITH src AS (SELECT ts, (ts AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')::date AS d, to_char(ts AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai', 'HH24:MI') AS hm, extract(doy FROM (ts AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai'))::int AS doy, round((sum(volume) FILTER (WHERE code='sh000001')/1e8)::numeric, 2) AS a, round((sum(volume) FILTER (WHERE code='sz399001')/1e8)::numeric, 2) AS b, round((sum(volume) FILTER (WHERE code='sh000300')/1e8)::numeric, 2) AS c FROM index_hour WHERE code IN ('sh000001','sz399001','sh000300') AND ts >= $__timeFrom() AND ts < $__timeTo() GROUP BY ts), banner AS (SELECT ((d + time '09:00') AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai') AS ts, to_char(d, 'MM"月"DD"日"') AS slot, to_char(d, 'MM"月"DD"日"') AS tip, NULL::numeric AS a, NULL::numeric AS b, NULL::numeric AS c FROM (SELECT DISTINCT d FROM src) s), hours AS (SELECT ts, repeat(chr(8203), doy * 20 + CASE hm WHEN '10:00' THEN 1 WHEN '11:00' THEN 2 WHEN '11:30' THEN 3 WHEN '14:00' THEN 4 WHEN '15:00' THEN 5 ELSE 6 END) AS slot, hm AS tip, a, b, c FROM src), lunch AS (SELECT ((d + time '12:00') AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai') AS ts, repeat(chr(8203), doy * 20 + 7) AS slot, '午休' AS tip, NULL::numeric AS a, NULL::numeric AS b, NULL::numeric AS c FROM src WHERE hm = '11:30'), gutter AS (SELECT ((d + time '16:00') AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai') + (n || ' hours')::interval AS ts, repeat(chr(8203), doy * 20 + 10 + n) AS slot, NULL::text AS tip, NULL::numeric AS a, NULL::numeric AS b, NULL::numeric AS c FROM src CROSS JOIN generate_series(1, 3) AS n WHERE hm = '15:00' AND d < (SELECT max(d) FROM src)) SELECT slot AS "刻度", tip AS "时间", a AS "上证指数", b AS "深证成指", c AS "沪深300" FROM (SELECT ts, slot, tip, a, b, c FROM banner UNION ALL SELECT ts, slot, tip, a, b, c FROM hours UNION ALL SELECT ts, slot, tip, a, b, c FROM lunch UNION ALL SELECT ts, slot, tip, a, b, c FROM gutter) u ORDER BY ts

WITH src AS (SELECT ts, (ts AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')::date AS d, to_char(ts AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai', 'HH24:MI') AS hm, extract(doy FROM (ts AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai'))::int AS doy, round((sum(volume) FILTER (WHERE code='sh000016')/1e8)::numeric, 2) AS a, round((sum(volume) FILTER (WHERE code='sz399006')/1e8)::numeric, 2) AS b, round((sum(volume) FILTER (WHERE code='sh000688')/1e8)::numeric, 2) AS c FROM index_hour WHERE code IN ('sh000016','sz399006','sh000688') AND ts >= $__timeFrom() AND ts < $__timeTo() GROUP BY ts), banner AS (SELECT ((d + time '09:00') AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai') AS ts, to_char(d, 'MM"月"DD"日"') AS slot, to_char(d, 'MM"月"DD"日"') AS tip, NULL::numeric AS a, NULL::numeric AS b, NULL::numeric AS c FROM (SELECT DISTINCT d FROM src) s), hours AS (SELECT ts, repeat(chr(8203), doy * 20 + CASE hm WHEN '10:00' THEN 1 WHEN '11:00' THEN 2 WHEN '11:30' THEN 3 WHEN '14:00' THEN 4 WHEN '15:00' THEN 5 ELSE 6 END) AS slot, hm AS tip, a, b, c FROM src), lunch AS (SELECT ((d + time '12:00') AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai') AS ts, repeat(chr(8203), doy * 20 + 7) AS slot, '午休' AS tip, NULL::numeric AS a, NULL::numeric AS b, NULL::numeric AS c FROM src WHERE hm = '11:30'), gutter AS (SELECT ((d + time '16:00') AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai') + (n || ' hours')::interval AS ts, repeat(chr(8203), doy * 20 + 10 + n) AS slot, NULL::text AS tip, NULL::numeric AS a, NULL::numeric AS b, NULL::numeric AS c FROM src CROSS JOIN generate_series(1, 3) AS n WHERE hm = '15:00' AND d < (SELECT max(d) FROM src)) SELECT slot AS "刻度", tip AS "时间", a AS "上证50", b AS "创业板指", c AS "科创50" FROM (SELECT ts, slot, tip, a, b, c FROM banner UNION ALL SELECT ts, slot, tip, a, b, c FROM hours UNION ALL SELECT ts, slot, tip, a, b, c FROM lunch UNION ALL SELECT ts, slot, tip, a, b, c FROM gutter) u ORDER BY ts

panels.title: 宽基成交额（亿元）
panels.description: 颜色与宽基成交量一致。

targets.rawSql: WITH src AS (SELECT ts, (ts AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')::date AS d, to_char(ts AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai', 'HH24:MI') AS hm, extract(doy FROM (ts AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai'))::int AS doy, round((sum(amount) FILTER (WHERE code='sh000001')/1e8)::numeric, 0) AS a, round((sum(amount) FILTER (WHERE code='sz399001')/1e8)::numeric, 0) AS b, round((sum(amount) FILTER (WHERE code='sh000300')/1e8)::numeric, 0) AS c FROM index_hour WHERE code IN ('sh000001','sz399001','sh000300') AND ts >= $__timeFrom() AND ts < $__timeTo() GROUP BY ts), banner AS (SELECT ((d + time '09:00') AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai') AS ts, to_char(d, 'MM"月"DD"日"') AS slot, to_char(d, 'MM"月"DD"日"') AS tip, NULL::numeric AS a, NULL::numeric AS b, NULL::numeric AS c FROM (SELECT DISTINCT d FROM src) s), hours AS (SELECT ts, repeat(chr(8203), doy * 20 + CASE hm WHEN '10:00' THEN 1 WHEN '11:00' THEN 2 WHEN '11:30' THEN 3 WHEN '14:00' THEN 4 WHEN '15:00' THEN 5 ELSE 6 END) AS slot, hm AS tip, a, b, c FROM src), lunch AS (SELECT ((d + time '12:00') AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai') AS ts, repeat(chr(8203), doy * 20 + 7) AS slot, '午休' AS tip, NULL::numeric AS a, NULL::numeric AS b, NULL::numeric AS c FROM src WHERE hm = '11:30'), gutter AS (SELECT ((d + time '16:00') AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai') + (n || ' hours')::interval AS ts, repeat(chr(8203), doy * 20 + 10 + n) AS slot, NULL::text AS tip, NULL::numeric AS a, NULL::numeric AS b, NULL::numeric AS c FROM src CROSS JOIN generate_series(1, 3) AS n WHERE hm = '15:00' AND d < (SELECT max(d) FROM src)) SELECT slot AS "刻度", tip AS "时间", a AS "上证指数", b AS "深证成指", c AS "沪深300" FROM (SELECT ts, slot, tip, a, b, c FROM banner UNION ALL SELECT ts, slot, tip, a, b, c FROM hours UNION ALL SELECT ts, slot, tip, a, b, c FROM lunch UNION ALL SELECT ts, slot, tip, a, b, c FROM gutter) u ORDER BY ts

panels.title: 结构成交额（亿元）
panels.description: 颜色与结构成交量一致。

targets.rawSql: WITH src AS (SELECT ts, (ts AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')::date AS d, to_char(ts AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai', 'HH24:MI') AS hm, extract(doy FROM (ts AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai'))::int AS doy, round((sum(amount) FILTER (WHERE code='sh000016')/1e8)::numeric, 0) AS a, round((sum(amount) FILTER (WHERE code='sz399006')/1e8)::numeric, 0) AS b, round((sum(amount) FILTER (WHERE code='sh000688')/1e8)::numeric, 0) AS c FROM index_hour WHERE code IN ('sh000016','sz399006','sh000688') AND ts >= $__timeFrom() AND ts < $__timeTo() GROUP BY ts), banner AS (SELECT ((d + time '09:00') AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai') AS ts, to_char(d, 'MM"月"DD"日"') AS slot, to_char(d, 'MM"月"DD"日"') AS tip, NULL::numeric AS a, NULL::numeric AS b, NULL::numeric AS c FROM (SELECT DISTINCT d FROM src) s), hours AS (SELECT ts, repeat(chr(8203), doy * 20 + CASE hm WHEN '10:00' THEN 1 WHEN '11:00' THEN 2 WHEN '11:30' THEN 3 WHEN '14:00' THEN 4 WHEN '15:00' THEN 5 ELSE 6 END) AS slot, hm AS tip, a, b, c FROM src), lunch AS (SELECT ((d + time '12:00') AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai') AS ts, repeat(chr(8203), doy * 20 + 7) AS slot, '午休' AS tip, NULL::numeric AS a, NULL::numeric AS b, NULL::numeric AS c FROM src WHERE hm = '11:30'), gutter AS (SELECT ((d + time '16:00') AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai') + (n || ' hours')::interval AS ts, repeat(chr(8203), doy * 20 + 10 + n) AS slot, NULL::text AS tip, NULL::numeric AS a, NULL::numeric AS b, NULL::numeric AS c FROM src CROSS JOIN generate_series(1, 3) AS n WHERE hm = '15:00' AND d < (SELECT max(d) FROM src)) SELECT slot AS "刻度", tip AS "时间", a AS "上证50", b AS "创业板指", c AS "科创50" FROM (SELECT ts, slot, tip, a, b, c FROM banner UNION ALL SELECT ts, slot, tip, a, b, c FROM hours UNION ALL SELECT ts, slot, tip, a, b, c FROM lunch UNION ALL SELECT ts, slot, tip, a, b, c FROM gutter) u ORDER BY ts

panels.title: 区间内最近一个交易日，按小时

targets.rawSql: WITH latest AS (SELECT max(ts) AS ts FROM index_hour WHERE ts >= $__timeFrom() AND ts < $__timeTo()) SELECT to_char(h.ts AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai', 'MM-DD HH24:MI') AS "小时", round((sum(volume) FILTER (WHERE code='sh000001')/1e8)::numeric, 2) AS "上证量", round((sum(amount) FILTER (WHERE code='sh000001')/1e8)::numeric, 0) AS "上证额", round((sum(volume) FILTER (WHERE code='sz399001')/1e8)::numeric, 2) AS "深成量", round((sum(amount) FILTER (WHERE code='sz399001')/1e8)::numeric, 0) AS "深成额", round((sum(volume) FILTER (WHERE code='sh000300')/1e8)::numeric, 2) AS "沪深300量", round((sum(amount) FILTER (WHERE code='sh000300')/1e8)::numeric, 0) AS "沪深300额", round((sum(volume) FILTER (WHERE code='sz399006')/1e8)::numeric, 2) AS "创业板量", round((sum(amount) FILTER (WHERE code='sz399006')/1e8)::numeric, 0) AS "创业板额", round((sum(volume) FILTER (WHERE code='sh000016')/1e8)::numeric, 2) AS "上证50量", round((sum(amount) FILTER (WHERE code='sh000016')/1e8)::numeric, 0) AS "上证50额", round((sum(volume) FILTER (WHERE code='sh000688')/1e8)::numeric, 2) AS "科创50量", round((sum(amount) FILTER (WHERE code='sh000688')/1e8)::numeric, 0) AS "科创50额" FROM index_hour h JOIN latest ON true WHERE h.ts >= (date_trunc('day', latest.ts AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai') AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai') AND h.ts < (date_trunc('day', latest.ts AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai') AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai') + interval '1 day' GROUP BY h.ts ORDER BY h.ts

SELECT (ts AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')::date AS "日期", round((sum(volume) FILTER (WHERE code='sh000001')/1e8)::numeric, 2) AS "上证量", round((sum(amount) FILTER (WHERE code='sh000001')/1e8)::numeric, 0) AS "上证额", round((sum(volume) FILTER (WHERE code='sz399001')/1e8)::numeric, 2) AS "深成量", round((sum(amount) FILTER (WHERE code='sz399001')/1e8)::numeric, 0) AS "深成额", round((sum(volume) FILTER (WHERE code='sh000300')/1e8)::numeric, 2) AS "沪深300量", round((sum(amount) FILTER (WHERE code='sh000300')/1e8)::numeric, 0) AS "沪深300额", round((sum(volume) FILTER (WHERE code='sz399006')/1e8)::numeric, 2) AS "创业板量", round((sum(amount) FILTER (WHERE code='sz399006')/1e8)::numeric, 0) AS "创业板额", round((sum(volume) FILTER (WHERE code='sh000016')/1e8)::numeric, 2) AS "上证50量", round((sum(amount) FILTER (WHERE code='sh000016')/1e8)::numeric, 0) AS "上证50额", round((sum(volume) FILTER (WHERE code='sh000688')/1e8)::numeric, 2) AS "科创50量", round((sum(amount) FILTER (WHERE code='sh000688')/1e8)::numeric, 0) AS "科创50额" FROM index_hour WHERE ts >= $__timeFrom() AND ts < $__timeTo() GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
